name: face-overlay
description: Real-time facial expression overlay for streaming, built on MediaPipe Face Landmarker. Runs as a standalone Electron app.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n vite,electron -c blue,green "vite" "wait-on tcp:5173 && cross-env ELECTRON_START_URL=http://localhost:5173 electron ."

author: sawaruto123

extendInfo.NSCameraUsageDescription: Face Overlay needs camera access to track your expressions.
